_comment: TEMPLATE, not a plan input. Every __OWNER_REQUIRED__ value is an owner decision; the preflight treats it as unset (INCOMPLETE). Keep the real copy OUTSIDE the repository, never commit it, and never put credentials in it (it holds none). Use as: terraform plan -var-file=<real copy>. Remove this _comment key from the real copy: Terraform rejects unknown keys and so does the preflight.
